about_blocks.text: Into Action Recovery Abbotsford is a men's residential recovery program on a rural property at 6705 Satchell Street in west Abbotsford, in BC's Fraser Valley. Into Action calls the site The Acreage, and the province's Assisted Living Registry lists it as Into Action Recovery Acreage, a registered supportive recovery residence (SU2024-000001) in the Fraser Health region.
about_blocks.html: Into Action Recovery Abbotsford is a men's residential recovery program on a rural property at 6705 Satchell Street in west Abbotsford, in BC's Fraser Valley. Into Action calls the site The Acreage, and the province's Assisted Living Registry lists it as Into Action Recovery Acreage, a registered supportive recovery residence (SU2024-000001) in the Fraser Health region.

about_blocks.text: The photos Into Action has published show a wide lounge with sofas, a dining room set with high tables and stools, a coffee and fruit counter, a group room lined with chairs and whiteboards, and a full gym with two power racks, cable machines and benches. Bedrooms range from single rooms with metal bed frames to a larger room with a queen bed, and a covered patio with outdoor sofas runs along the side of the building.

about_blocks.text: Into Action describes Abbotsford as multi-level residential programming: clinical oversight combined with therapeutic and community-based support, in a home-like setting rather than an institution. The centre treats addiction as a chronic, relapsing condition and says many men need more than a short stay, which is why Abbotsford offers recovery housing and transitional housing on the same site.

about_blocks.text: The First Stage program is a 60-day minimum with extensions. It includes daily educational and process groups, one-to-one counselling, 12-step, NA and SMART Recovery meetings, and aftercare planning. Second Stage residents get more freedom, keep a curfew and chores, and go to work or school while they keep up their meetings.

about_blocks.text: Abbotsford is a non-medical residence. Detox comes first, at another facility, and medical care runs through a virtual provider or a man's own doctor. Into Action is a private-pay program and does not publish a price for Abbotsford; admissions explains costs on the first call. Families who are calling for a son, husband or brother can ask the same team how the two stages fit together before anyone commits.

centre.faq_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Into Action Recovery Abbotsford

faqs.question: What is The Acreage in Abbotsford?

answer_blocks.text: The Acreage is Into Action Recovery's rural site at 6705 Satchell Street in west Abbotsford. BC's Assisted Living Registry lists it as Into Action Recovery Acreage, a registered supportive recovery residence, registration SU2024-000001, in Fraser Health.

faqs.question: What kind of program runs in Abbotsford?

answer_blocks.text: Into Action describes multi-level residential programming here, with recovery housing and transitional housing for men. First Stage is a structured live-in program of at least 60 days, and Second Stage is a sober transitional stay of 30 days or more.

faqs.question: How much does Into Action Recovery Abbotsford cost?

answer_blocks.text: Into Action does not publish a price for Abbotsford, and recovery.com shows no estimate for this house. It is a private-pay program, and admissions gives the full cost and payment options on the first call.

faqs.question: What facilities does the Abbotsford house have?

answer_blocks.text: The photos Into Action has published show a full gym with power racks and cable machines, a group room, a large lounge, a dining room with high tables, a coffee counter, single and shared bedrooms and a covered patio. recovery.com also lists air-conditioned rooms and outdoor space.

faqs.question: Does Into Action Recovery Abbotsford do detox?

answer_blocks.text: No. It is a non-medical supportive recovery residence with no doctors or nurses on site. Men who need withdrawal management complete detox elsewhere first, and Into Action's intake team can help arrange it.

faqs.question: How far is Abbotsford from Vancouver?

answer_blocks.text: About an hour by car along Highway 1. The house is in rural west Abbotsford, roughly 15 minutes from the city centre, 20 minutes from Langley and 35 minutes from Chilliwack. Admissions coordinates arrival and travel if needed.

faqs.question: How long do men stay in Abbotsford?

answer_blocks.text: First Stage runs at least 60 days and can be extended. Into Action's other pages mention 30, 60 and 90-day options, and recovery.com lists 30 to 90 days. Second Stage, if you choose it, usually adds 30 days or more.

faqs.question: Is the Abbotsford program only for men?

answer_blocks.text: Yes. Into Action has served only adult men since it opened in 2012, at every location.
answer_blocks.html: Yes. Into Action has served only adult men since it opened in 2012, at every location.

faqs.question: Can I bring my own food or supplements?

answer_blocks.text: Yes. Into Action lets residents bring snacks and protein powder, with a resident fridge and dry-goods storage. Snacks are also provided at all hours.

faqs.question: Can I work while living at the Abbotsford house?

answer_blocks.text: Not during First Stage, which is a full-time program. In Second Stage, men can work, go to school or take part in community activities while they keep a curfew, do daily chores and go to support meetings.
